title: Drawing Interaction Fidelity — Pan, Magnet, Price Labels
changes: Fixed chart left/right pan: dragging left moves candles left, dragging right moves candles right; neither action changes time-density/price scale.
CTRL magnet now presents pre-first-click OHLC preview and remains available when editing a selected drawing handle, with exact candle OHLC snap.
Selected rectangles show upper/lower log-price axis labels attached to the corresponding price levels.
Selected long/short positions show entry label and target/stop percentage values, preserving existing live-vs-limit entry and nominal-value semantics.
Restored high-contrast white mouse crosshair dashed lines.
Unchanged: chart engine, 4H/1D & line/candles, HA guide, startup v1.9.0, 10-second data/Signal Spotlight/RR, R2 sync API.
requiredDeploy: GitHub Pages: replace five files in MultiAssetLiquidityRadar. No Worker redeploy.
notes: Use the exact uploaded/previous v2.0.1 base; no exchange/Worker behavior changed.
Local Chromium interaction tests use synthetic price series, not live exchange or R2 endpoint tests.
